verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-integrated video platform that runs an MCP server, so it could plausibly ship installable agent skills, and the question applies. However, the evidence never mentions skills or any way to list a skill's instructions and scripts before installing or read its files afterward. Templates and the MCP server are different features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
